gui.naturalis.trait_guide.title: Morph Traits
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.subtitle: Scroll for Walkers + Naturalis trait bubbles (see also woodwalkers wiki)
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.static.title: Static
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.static.body: Rooted morphs (shulker, aechor plant, …). You cannot walk or be driven by wander instinct; you stay anchored where you transform.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.floating.title: Floating
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.floating.body: Surface floater (chicken, duck, waterfowl…). You bob on water and cannot stay underwater — paired with Walkers stand-on-fluid (water).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.scentbound.bod: Keen nose. Smell trails and scent hints are stronger so you can track prey and players by odor.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.photophobic.bo: Sun-stressed or cave-adapted morphs. Bright daylight weakens or hurts you; prefer shade and night.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.wanderer.title: Wanderer
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.wanderer.body: When idle, the morph’s wander instinct may move and look around for you until you master the Wander knowledge branch.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.hunter.title: Hunter
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.hunter.body: Predatory morphs may lunge toward suitable prey while instincts are active.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.nyctalop.title: Nyctalop
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.nyctalop.body: Night-adapted sight. Dark places feel natural; harsh sun can be punishing.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.quadruped.body: Four-legged body rules: inventory and interaction limits match paws, not human hands.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.flying.title: Flying
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.flying.body: Aerial morphs. Creative-style flight while morphed; often includes slow falling. Bat, bee, phantom, Aether / Naturalist flyers, …
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.aquatic.title: Aquatic
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.aquatic.body: Breathe underwater and swim faster. Fish, dolphins, axolotls, turtles, and many modded sea life.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.climb.title: Climb Blocks
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.climb.body: Scale walls like spiders. Spiders, cave spiders, and climbing lizards / gecko-like morphs.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.slow_falling.b: Soft landings unless you crouch. Chickens, parrots, and many birds.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.nocturnal.body: Sleeps by day, active at night — Walkers default for some night creatures.
Undead-like: direct sunlight can set you on fire. Zombies, skeletons, phantoms, many undead mods.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.temperature.bo: Hurt when the climate is too hot or too cold for the morph (e.g. snow golem).
Blocks interacting with listed entities/tags (raiders vs villagers, …).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.undrownable.bo: Does not drown, but does not regain air underwater either. Golems and some constructs.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.powder_snow.bo: Walk atop powder snow. Rabbits, goats, polar bears, arctic morphs.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.cant_freeze.bo: Powder snow / freezing damage ignored. Ice and snow-adapted creatures.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.cant_swim.body: Swimming disabled — heavy bodies sink awkwardly. Iron golem, ravager, wardens, giant constructs.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.stand_on_fluid: Walk on a fluid surface. Water for Naturalis Floating morphs; lava for striders / magma cubes.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.attack_for_hea: Hunger disabled — heal by dealing damage (classic undead / zombie style).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.no_physics.bod: Pass through blocks (or fall through them) like a vex / phantom ghost.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.humanoid.title: Humanoid
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.humanoid.body: Hitbox scales with a humanoid model. Best for zombie / villager-like shapes.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.mob_effect.bod: Applies a status effect to you and/or nearby entities (e.g. dolphin’s grace).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.immunity.title: Immunity
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.immunity.body: Suppresses a specific mob effect (e.g. wither skeletons ignore wither).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.instant_die.bo: Certain damage messages kill instantly (e.g. turtles and lightning).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.reinforcements: Nearby allies of listed types help when you are hurt.
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.prey.title: Prey
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.prey.body: Listed hunters actively chase this morph (wolves vs skeletons, …).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.feared.title: Feared
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.feared.body: Listed mobs flee from you (skeletons from wolves).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.rider.title: Rider
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.rider.body: Ride listed mobs that are not normally rideable (skeleton on spider, …).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.idea_sticky.bo: Possible future trait — cling to ceilings / leave slime trails (slimes, snails).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.idea_biolumine: Possible future trait — emit light in caves (glow squid, firefly, deep-sea morphs).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.idea_pack.body: Possible future trait — buffs when near same-species players/mobs (wolves, dolphins).
gui.naturalis.trait_guide.idea_echolocat: Possible future trait — pulse outlines of nearby entities in the dark (bats, dolphins, warden).

gui.naturalis.knowledge.source.special: Special: swim, fly, climb, runner/sneak/jump traits

advancements.naturalis.environment.heat_: Brave the desert heat in a hot-climate morph.
advancements.naturalis.environment.water: Survive in water with an aquatic morph.
advancements.naturalis.environment.dehyd: A water-based creature survives 10 seconds away from water.
advancements.naturalis.environment.night: As a nyctalop hostile morph, see clearly in deep darkness.
advancements.naturalis.diet.carnivore_pr: As a carnivore morph, thrive on meat and raw prey.
advancements.naturalis.diet.herbivore_pr: As a herbivore morph, digest plants at peak efficiency.
advancements.naturalis.diet.iron_stomach: Force down a diet your morph body dislikes.
advancements.naturalis.instinct.wild_wan: Stay still long enough for your morph instincts to move on their own.
advancements.naturalis.instinct.survival: Your morph instincts counter danger before you react.
advancements.naturalis.resonance.first_b: Form a permanent bond with one mastered morph.
advancements.naturalis.resonance.resonan: Activate Resonance and fight through your bonded morph.

advancements.naturalis.resonance.rebirth: Rebirth from Lost and leave your old body behind.
advancements.naturalis.resonance.human_d: As human, eat outside your bonded diet at 80 humanity or lower.

advancements.naturalis.resonance.tool_de: Use tools as human at 60 humanity or lower.
advancements.naturalis.resonance.tool_re: At 20 humanity or lower, your human hands refuse tools.
advancements.naturalis.resonance.morph_s: At 20 humanity or lower, attempt to sleep in bed while morphed.

gui.naturalis.survival_as.trait.undead_h: Harming potions heal you; healing potions hurt you.
gui.naturalis.survival_as.trait.villager: You are drawn to fresh villager brains — and they are afraid of you.
gui.naturalis.survival_as.trait.water_fe: Water unsettles or harms you; stay on dry ground when you can.
